summary: The patch addresses the issue by converting non-string iterable values to lists, but it may not handle all edge cases and could be improved for clarity.

issues.description: The patch converts all non-string iterables to lists, which might not be appropriate for all types of iterables (e.g., sets, generators). This could lead to unexpected behavior or performance issues.
The function `convert_to_list` could be made more readable by adding a docstring explaining its purpose and behavior.
